svg.title: Figure 13 · Raw SVI parameter changes
svg.desc: Baseline (a,b,rho,m,s) = (0.015,0.05,-0.6,0.04,0.25). The second curve raises b to 0.08; the third lowers rho to -0.85. Positivity conditions alone do not establish no arbitrage.
